game_concept: A action puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring, a hidden spring: the cave miner must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring: a hidden spring
core_gameplay_loop: In Hidden Spring, repeat each round: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times. Each round, a new crystal shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the loop_runs value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 550 points of crystal shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 550, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Condition Builder
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_runs changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Hidden Spring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 550 within 43 seconds.
